components.name: chimera-core-ppsspp (integration)
components.license: MIT, with GPL-2.0-or-later patches and driver

components.name: glslang
components.license: BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, MIT and Apache-2.0, with its generated parser under GPL-3.0 with the Bison exception
components.note: PPSSPP's own fork, a submodule of it. The compiler that turns the GLSL PPSSPP writes for its Vulkan renderer into SPIR-V: the front end and the SPIR-V writer, without the optimiser and without HLSL. Used only when the Renderer setting is vulkan-hw.

components.name: SPIRV-Cross
components.note: A submodule of PPSSPP. Its shader translator reads a compiled shader back with it. Used only when the Renderer setting is vulkan-hw.

components.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator
components.note: One header and its implementation file, carried in PPSSPP's tree. Its licence is the comment at the top of the header.
